population.eligibility: conformant AND network eip155:8453 AND scheme exact AND amount a positive integer <= 50000 units (0.05 USDC) AND not one of our own hosts

beneficiary_concentration.note: 174 addresses collect for 314 doors, and the three largest collect for 91 of them. A directory of many hosts is not a market of many beneficiaries.

what_this_is_not: No payment was sent and nothing was signed. DRY records what each door ASKS, never what it delivers.
DELIVERED / REFUSED / MISMATCH cannot be known until a settled run; every row here reads DRY or NO_CHALLENGE.
This is not a recommendation of any host, and no host was contacted.
reproduce: python3 scripts/grants/x402-settlement-census.py --census <conformance jsonl> --max-hosts 400 --out <path>   # DRY is the default; SETTLE=1 is required to send money
